name: Undo Ba
description: A restrained, elegant theme for small strength and conditioning studios: a stone ground with paper bands, charcoal text and dark bands, warm-grey hairlines and one deep oxblood accent, Bellefair headings and Inter text; a transparent header over the home photograph; a home page that reads as a fine numbered timeline of the training week (01 to 06 in thin serif numerals, the rep counter); a charcoal footer band inviting a free trial; with about, programs (one session in six phases), coaches, memberships and prices, a journal, a newsletter and trial booking. The studio details and the memberships with their prices are each edited in one place.

fonts.role: headings, the wordmark, the timeline numerals and prices
body text, labels, navigation, forms and buttons
